title: Swords that shoot still swing; Zenith is a pure projectile weapon that never blocks
player_outcome: Starfury, Enchanted Sword, Terra Blade, Meowmere, Star Wrath and the other 10 sword-plus-projectile weapons now hit with the blade as well as firing. Zenith keeps firing on every click instead of doing nothing while its blades are out.
design: ItemDef: add bool NoMelee (Terraria's noMelee: the swing is animation only). ItemUseTable.Resolve skips the UseStyle.Swing melee inference when NoMelee is set.
ContentValidator.Items: error when an item has NoMelee and a meleeSwing behaviour.
ShootProjectileParams: add int? MaxActive. null means 1 for returning projectiles (boomerangs, flails; today's rule) and unlimited otherwise; 0 means unlimited; Validate MaxActive >= 0.

ItemUseSystem.Shooting.Shoot: replace the 'Returns > 0 && any out' check (line 335) with limit = MaxActive ?? (Returns > 0 ? 1 : 0). When limit > 0 and this owner's live projectiles of that def + Count > limit, return Blocked.

ItemUseSystem.Use melee gate (line 154): for Melee|Thrust items also accept Shot, and NoAmmo/NoMana/Blocked produced by the shoot branch (tracked by a local flag), converting those to Swung so cooldown and animation apply. Swung is raised as before (only on new animations after P1-10).
data/items/lunar.json zenith: add "noMelee": true, remove its meleeSwing behaviour, set shootProjectile "maxActive": 0 (keep count 3, spread 16).
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/ItemUseSystem.cs — melee gate accepts Shot and shoot failures
tests: ArsenalTests.SwordsWithProjectilesAlsoSwing: for starfury and enchanted_sword, with a slime 1.5 m ahead and Aim pitched 35° up (the projectile misses): outcome Shot, Melee.ActiveSwings == 1, projectiles >= 1, and after 30 ticks the slime is damaged
ArsenalTests.ZenithNeverBlocks: two uses with ResetUse() between both return Shot; Projectiles.All.Count == 6; Melee.ActiveSwings == 0
Validator test: an item with noMelee plus meleeSwing is rejected

combat.cmds: 'give starfury 1' / 'wield starfury' / 'killall' / 'aim 0 0 1' / 'spawn green_slime 1 2' / 'ai off' / 'use' / 'assert projectiles.count >= 1' / 'wait 0.6' / 'assert npcs.alive_life < 14' / 'ai on' / 'killall'
verification: dotnet test; Strata.Tools validate; smoke combat.cmds PASS
Manual: Enchanted Sword melee plus beam; Zenith spam fires continuously
risks: Balance: 14 weapons gain melee damage they never had in this build. That matches Terraria, so accept it.
